title: Specified full configuration
statement: Let $x$ be a Boolean string, let $E$ and $G$ be finite Boolean-alphabet Turing machines, and choose states $e_e,e_x$ of $E$ and $g_e,g_x$ of $G$. Given an iteration-body state $s$, an input-head position $p<|x|+2$, and an integer $z$, the specified configuration has state $s$, input-head position $p$, and empty output. Work tape $0$ contains all of $x$ with its head at $z$, while all other work tapes are blank with their heads at $0$.
hypotheses_covered: Finite machines $E$ and $G$ over Boolean symbols
